6379.title: Provider maintenance bypasses compaction admission
6379.rootCauseOneLine: The compaction wait gate checks bb command requests but misses the open compaction item in a provider-owned maintenance turn.
6379.proposedFix: Recognize open root compaction items in active provider-owned turns while preserving ordinary requested-turn steering.
6379.caveats: Reproduced twice at the public server dispatch boundary using real migrated SQLite; the live Pi error/message-loss cascade was not run.
